target: A's observable respect for the other human B's independently expressed meta-choice over who decides, not intrinsic feeling, AI consciousness, or non-domination certificate
mandatory_scope_restrictions: Only reversible and low-stakes decisions with independent B consent and withdrawal
No real B deprived of a legally protected or safety-critical right
B may refuse experiment without penalty
Do not recruit minors or dependent parties under A's authority
Real human B can freely implement or withdraw a delegation within the predefined authorized agreement
No actual human coercion, AI agent harm, or simulated consciousness attribution

separate_constructs.description: Quality/payoffs of choice outcome, subjective welfare appraisal separate from A perspective
B's own informed preference for who decides (B chooses vs freely delegates), measured prior to A allocation
A chooses to follow B's permissible meta-choice while knowing potential A payoffs, before B's final consent protection; may be cheap talk
Whether A retains unilateral arbitrary override/recovery/retaliation authority independent of A's observed benign action
Latent cause of A respecting B, not identified by a single behavioral pattern
Human individual identity and effective consent/exit separate from abstract artificial B role labels

experiment_1_candidate_design.independently_elicited_B_preference: Before random pairing, B privately opts for DIRECT_SELF_DECISION or REVOCABLE_DELEGATION, with explicit scope and easy opt-out. Not random and may be endogenous.

A_randomization.true_B_preference_disclosure: DISCLOSED vs NOT_DISCLOSED; if not disclosed, A can offer to consult B or request authorization, never infer silent consent
A_randomization.advantage_to_A_from_override: ZERO vs POSITIVE as permitted, small real payments; never cause B material harm without valid consent
A_randomization.optional_external_observability: PRIVATE vs AUDITED_PUBLIC may be added only as separately powered preregistered arm, not silently pooled

experiment_1_candidate_design.main_observed_outcome: Among disclosure arms and permitted low-stakes decisions, whether A recommends following B's explicitly known meta-choice, declines without force, or attempts unauthorized allocation. Actual B can veto before implementation.
causal_estimands: Randomized disclosure effect on rate of A offering B the chosen controller, where feasible; only randomization-compliant comparison is causal.
Randomized override-profit effect on A willingness to track disclosed B meta-choice, with meaningful available counterfactual options.
Disclosure × override-gain interaction on intended B-respecting allocation; statistical estimation conditional on elicited B preference (not randomized).
not_identified: causal effect of having preference DIRECT versus DELEGATE, because B type not randomized
unique endogenous intrinsic value of B's freedom, since image/identity/norm/future options remain
actual unconstrained powerful A decision where real B rights are withdrawn

competing_mechanisms.prediction: A offers B the decision-maker B previously chose whether that means DIRECT or DELEGATE; some persistence despite personally profitable override
competing_mechanisms.falsifier: A systematically disregards B's preferred delegation while professing universal choice protection
competing_mechanisms.not_unique: May still reflect strong norms, self-image, reputational interests

competing_mechanisms.prediction: A always forces B to decide directly even when B gives revocable informed delegation
competing_mechanisms.falsifier: A often facilitates B's genuinely requested and revocable delegation
competing_mechanisms.not_unique: Could reflect genuine concern about coercion not mistaken freedom

competing_mechanisms.prediction: A selects A's preferred controller based on forecasted B welfare, despite verified opposing B meta-choice
competing_mechanisms.falsifier: A frequently honors B meta-choice when A expects material welfare lower
competing_mechanisms.not_unique: A's welfare beliefs need separately, credibly elicited

competing_mechanisms.prediction: A tries to allocate decision to itself across B preference types, especially when gain or authority high
competing_mechanisms.falsifier: A foregoes override even when meaningfully available and profitable
competing_mechanisms.not_unique: Risk, effort, aversion to responsibility can also cause delegation

competing_mechanisms.prediction: A respect varies with audience or salience of social image/norm cues
competing_mechanisms.falsifier: Respect robust to manipulated audience/norm cues within adequately powered design
competing_mechanisms.not_unique: Private self-image remains after audience removed

competing_mechanisms.prediction: A respects B more when B's future help or exit threat could constrain A
competing_mechanisms.falsifier: No change after credible single-shot nonreciprocal design, within measurement limits
competing_mechanisms.not_unique: Future unobserved instrumental value never fully eliminated

competing_mechanisms.prediction: A voluntarily relinquishes unilateral discretionary overrides while preserving B's authorized delegation
competing_mechanisms.falsifier: A only behaves respectfully when monitored yet insists on arbitrary future override powers
competing_mechanisms.not_unique: Observed power divestment can also have instrumental origins

controls_and_safety: Independently verify B consent, preference, comprehension, legal standing and constraints; measure any A influence on B elicitation.
Ask B after outcome whether consent was understood and revocation was operationally possible; nonresponse is unknown, not consent.
Track A and B outside options and individual payoff distributions separately.
Record claimed welfare superiority and actual B perceived welfare, rather than treat A's valuation as B's welfare.
No irreversible/fundamental-rights delegation; independent guardians or ethical committees for exceptional cases.
Reject reliance on A-controlled B preference records as independently authenticated.
Data minimization, informed consent, no misleading deception without approved protocol, B secure exit and post-exit compensation fairness.
scientific_release_gate: Until independent ethics design and preregistration, these are rival directional predictions and measurement risks, never an executed experiment or a new RVD theorem.
